title: LiteCowork Interactive Artifact Package Manifest v1

host_protocol_min.description: The validator requires this value to be less than or equal to host_protocol_max.

host_protocol_max.description: The Runtime supervisor protocol version must fall within the declared inclusive range.

requested_capabilities.description: Advisory declaration only. It grants no authority. V1 read access requires exact owner-selected Resource revisions; saving always requires a separate host-owned confirmation.

packagePath.description: Canonical relative POSIX path. The fixed root manifest.json is not listed as an asset; entrypoint is listed in assets. The package validator rejects dot-segments, duplicates after platform normalization, links, and any path not declared here.
